title: Term Life Insurance Free-Look Return and Owner Cancellation
content:
## Free look

The owner may return a new Term Life Insurance policy for a full refund of every premium paid. The returned policy must be received no later than the policy delivery date plus the product's free-look days. The free-look end is found by adding the free-look days in calendar days to the policy delivery date; a policy received on that day is in time. When the sale replaced existing coverage, the product's replacement free-look days replace the ordinary free-look days. The delivery date and whether the sale was a replacement are read from the policy record. A free-look return voids the contract from issue.

| Delivery date (hypothetical) | Sale | Free-look end | Received on the end | Received the next day |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4 June | ordinary (10 days) | 14 June | in time | not in time |
| 4 June | replacement (30 days) | 4 July | in time | not in time |

## Cancellation after the free-look period

After the free-look period the owner may cancel by signed request. Cancellation takes effect on the date requested, which may not be earlier than the date the request is received, and premium paid for complete policy months after the month in which cancellation takes effect is refunded. Monthly EFT installments are never refunded on cancellation. A cancelled policy cannot be reinstated.

Hypothetical: an annual-mode policy with policy months beginning on the 1st, paid to 1 January of the next year, cancelled effective 20 August — the policy month of August is not refunded; premium for September through December (four complete policy months) is refunded.
